default/31653.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: An ancient monument covered with indecipherable hieroglyphs.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You sense the presence of someone nearby. It is the Crimson Duchess, a follower of Beleth who is also searching for the Resonance Amulet. You cannot fight her by normal means. Fight her as Kekropus directed in his report.

links.text: Take out your weapon and examine the area in which you feel the presence.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune starts emitting light as soon as you near the Tablet of Vision.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Further communication with this tablet is futile. Get the next Resonance Amulet from Master Medea in Goddard.

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: As you near the Tablet of Vision, you sense a presence. It's the one who sold out to the demon for absolute power! Sadly, he underestimated his own potential. No amount of worldly acclaim was enough for him. You have a book with the story of his terrible end with you! Have you rea…

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune starts emitting light as soon as you near the Tablet of Vision.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Further communion with this tablet is futile. You must get the next Stone of Commune from Valdis, the Grand Magister of Rune Castle Town Library.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: As you near the Tablet of Vision, you sense the presence of the one who sought ultimate power by currying the favor of the King. It's the tyrant! He smiles smugly while rubbing the Stone of Commune.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune starts emitting light as soon as you near the Tablet of Vision.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Further communion with this tablet is futile. You must find the next Stone of Commune! The one who has the next Stone of Commune is Seer Skahi in Goddard Castle Town.

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You sense evil around you.

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune starts emitting light as soon as you near the Tablet of Vision.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The power is gone. Find the man you saw in the vision!

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet is vibrating softly. Someone is nearby!

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet begins to buzz when you pick up the Stone of Commune.

links.text: Touch the Tablet of Vision with the Stone of Commune.

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet goes still and quiet, as if nothing had ever happened. The Stone of Commune beckons you to visit Priest Bastian of Goddard Castle Town .

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune exists near the tablet. Putting your hands on the tablet will reveal the location of the stone. Put your hands on the tablet.

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Ancient, indecipherable hieroglyphs are engraved upon the tablet. They emit a mysterious, dim light. There is something magical and powerful in the tablet.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Putting your hands on the tablet, the location of the Stone of Commune again becomes clear. Grand Magister Fairen has the fourth Stone of Commune. Go and get it from him!

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Bloody footprints and sword marks scar the ground. Something definitely happened here! Could these be pawprints of the kitty cat I saw earlier? No, these are the pawprints of a dark panther! I sense the presence of someone and the power of the Stone of Commune.

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The marks on the ground must be the remnants of the battle between Waldstein and Iconoclasis. Waldstein seems quite determined to complete the Pilgrimage of the Tablet of Vision. The Tablet of Vision is engraved with incomprehensible hieroglyphs.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Further communion with this tablet is futile. You must find the next Stone of Commune! Guard Bayard of Goddard Castle Town has it! Find him!

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet is vibrating softly. I sense that someone nearby has a Stone of Commune!

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: When you approach the Tablet of Vision with the Stone of Commune, the tablet begins buzzing softly.

links.text: Touch the Stone of Commune to the tablet.

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet goes still and quiet, as if nothing had ever happened. I must find Elena ! I'm sure she has the Stone of Commune!

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-01.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Stone of Commune exists near the tablet. Putting your hands on the tablet will reveal the location of the stone. Put your hands on the tablet.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-05.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Ancient, indecipherable hieroglyphs are engraved upon the tablet. They emit a mysterious, dim light. There is something magical and powerful in the tablet.

links.text: Commune with the Tablet of Vision.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-07.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Putting your hands on the tablet, the location of the Stone of Commune again becomes clear. Master Tobald in Goddard Castle Town has the stone! Find Master Tobald and get it from him.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Crimson Duchess, a follower of Beleth, eyes you suspiciously. She already holds the Resonance Amulet and seems ready to return to Beleth.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Crimson Duchess is still attacking you! Defeat her first!

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You sense a disturbance near the tablet. The time hasn't yet come for you to prove yourself. Come back later.

Q00069_SagaOfTheTrickster/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Thoughts beyond understanding race through your mind, and you hear the fain whisper of a female voice. You sense the existence of the next Resonance Amulet. It seems to be in the hands of the female Kamael Master Medea in Goddard.

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: He had absolute power, but if the outcome is already known, what's the point? Eternal life is no substitute for dignity. The title of Sword Master is a heavy burden. He forgot why he took up the sword in the first place!

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The time has come to examine the Tablet of Vision, but don't take your eyes off of Iron for a second! You'll need all your skills against him!

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You sense a disturbance near the tablet. The time hasn't yet come for you to prove yourself.

Q00073_SagaOfTheDuelist/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Countless thoughts beyond comprehension sear painfully into your brain. You hear the faint whisper of a woman's voice. A vision appears of a man, smiling down upon the Stone of Commune! It appears he's in a vast library. It's Valdis, Grand Magister of Rune Castle Town Library!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Overlord Atrus has no more qualities of a king than any common Orc! He's no more than a tyrant!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The tablet is engraved with indecipherable hieroglyphs. Atrus's offensive continues!

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You sense a disturbance near the Tablet of Vision. The time has not yet come for you to prove yourself.

Q00077_SagaOfTheDominator/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Countless thoughts beyond comprehension sear painfully into your brain. You hear the faint whisper of a female's voice... What is a king? A king holds his people, land, army and magic in his arms. What an awesome responsibility! The Silvery Spidersilk shines in the dark. The seer …

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: It's Ezekiel! I read about him in that book I got from Black Cat!

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Ezekiel must be dealt with first.

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Someone else is currently communing with the Tablet of Vision. Please wait.

Q00081_SagaOfTheGhostHunter/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: You feel a strange, disconnected force enter your body. You begin to see visions. You see a landscape, I see a male Human. The house engulfed in a dark aura... The are appears to be located near the Ketra Orc Outpost. You feel the Tablet of Vision weakening.

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Suddenly, someone appears on the other side of the tablet. Could it be Haures, the subject of that book that came from Hollint?

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: I'm certain that Haures has the Stone of Commune I need to access the Tablet of Vision. I must get it away from her!

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Somewhere far away, people are fighting. Don't get involved. Wait and see what happens.

Q00087_SagaOfEvasSaint/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: New knowledge is seared painfully into your brain. Some secrets of the Tablet of Vision are becoming clear. Suddenly everything goes white, and a familiar face comes into view... It's...! Bastian in the Goddard Castle Town? And then the vision is gone!

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Putting your hands on the tablet, your entire body is knocked back by something powerful but invisible. Then, it begins to appear.

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Tablet of Vision is inaccessible without the Stone of Commune. Defeat Vision Guardian Shakiel, and take it from him.

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Someone else is currently communing with the Tablet of Vision. Come back later.

Q00093_SagaOfTheSpectralMaster/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Tablet of Vision begins to be wrapped up in brightness. Thunderous chanting clogs your mind and yet gives you understand of something.... something that cannot be understood! You hear a familiar woman's voice whispering again. The location of the next Stone of Commune is gradu…

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Archangel Iconoclasis? He must be the winged one I sensed before. I'm sure he has the Stone of Commune. !

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: First I must defeat the Archangel Iconoclasis and get the next Stone of Commune from him.

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Someone around here has the Stone of Commune, but it's too noisy now. Wait until it quiets down.

Q00095_SagaOfTheHellKnight/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Countless thoughts beyond comprehension sear painfully into your brain. You see a vision of a woman in a blue dress... I know where the next Stone of Commune is! I know that Guard Bayard of Goddard Castle Town has it! Find him!

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Lillian looks just like she did in the vision! Beware of her.

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Lillian serves that devil Hallate, and we must be wary of her evil ways! Kill her and take her Stone of Commune!

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: There's a fight going on over there. Wait and see what happens.

Q00096_SagaOfTheSpectralDancer/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: New knowledge is painfully seared into your brain. The secrets of the Tablet of Vision are becoming clear. As the pain subsides, a familiar face appears... It's Elena! And then the vision fades...Find Elena ! She has the first Stone of Commune!

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-02.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Putting your hands on the slate, your entire body is knocked back by something powerful but invisible. Then, it begins to appear.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-03.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Tablet of Vision cannot be accessed without the Stone of Commune. Defeat Archangel Iconoclasis, and take it from him.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-04.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: Someone else is currently communing with the Tablet of Vision. Come back later.

Q00100_SagaOfTheMaestro/7-06.htm.text: Tablet of Vision: The Tablet of Vision becomes overwhelmed by bright lights. While you are holding the stone to work on it, you start to acquire a new sense of knowledge as you hear the voices of thousands reading scriptures in the background. You now realize the truth of the world and yet understa…
